equity.level_reason: Only age and sex appear, as descriptors of individual iVDPV cases. Conflict, insecurity and country income level are geography or setting, not social-position dimensions.

equity.equity_measurement: Countries and their national OPV3 coverage (cited from WHO/UNICEF) are geographic, not SPD; developing and middle-income country framing is country income group.

notes: No statistical procedures; replication duration is estimated from VP1 divergence assuming ~1% per year, treated as measurement. Routine coverage per country is cited from WHO/UNICEF and only set beside detections. The headline comparisons are counts and shares across reporting periods, set side by side.
view_issues: The intro names a new cVDPV outbreak in Pakistan, but the cVDPV section lists new outbreaks in Chad, China and Yemen; the table dates China's outbreak to 2011–2012. The aVDPV section says June 2012 while the period starts July 2012.
